rules.overdue: status OPEN and due_current before today
rules.corrected: corrected odds = raw odds_now minus the mean signed error of the event's active judgment tags, held between 1 and 99. odds_now is never overwritten; the raw number keeps getting scored.

tag_meanings.timing: did a dated step arrive when the graph said
tag_meanings.brakes: did someone step in to stop or soften it (rescue, extension, waiver, backstop)
tag_meanings.actor: did a government or company do the dramatic thing or the routine thing
tag_meanings.market: Earth2's odds differ from a recorded market number; who was right
tag_meanings.pace: did it arrive sooner or larger than the recorded consensus

pace.rule: share of settled pace questions answered on the script side; write a pace question so the script side means sooner or larger than the recorded consensus

questions.source: Federal Register and Congress.gov
questions.settle_cmd: python3 earth2/scorecard.py settle Q-0044 --outcome YES_OR_NO --as-of 2027-06-30 --source "Federal Register and Congress.gov" --evidence "WHAT THE SOURCE SHOWS"

questions.text: By June 30, 2027, will the US government take or agree to take equity, warrants or a golden share in OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI or Alphabet?
questions.test: YES if between Nov 26, 2026 and Jun 30, 2027 a federal department or agency release, a Federal Register notice, or a company SEC filing discloses that the US government holds, or has signed a binding agreement or letter of intent to acquire, any equity, warrant, convertible instrument or special voting share in OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI or Alphabet. Grants, contracts and compute purchases without equity do not count. NO otherwise.
questions.source: Federal Register; department press releases; SEC EDGAR filings of Anthropic and Alphabet
questions.settle_cmd: python3 earth2/scorecard.py settle Q-0045 --outcome YES_OR_NO --as-of 2027-06-30 --source "Federal Register; department press releases; SEC EDGAR filings of Anthropic and Alphabet" --evidence "WHAT THE SOURCE SHOWS"

questions.text: Will TCS end fiscal 2027 with fewer employees than a year earlier while its full-year operating profit rises?
questions.test: From TCS's Q4 FY2027 results release and fact sheet: YES if total workforce at March 31, 2027 is below workforce at March 31, 2026 AND consolidated FY2027 operating income (EBIT, INR, excluding exceptional items as TCS reports it) is above FY2026; NO otherwise.
questions.source: Tata Consultancy Services Q4 FY2027 results and fact sheet filed with BSE and NSE
questions.settle_cmd: python3 earth2/scorecard.py settle Q-0046 --outcome YES_OR_NO --as-of 2027-04-30 --source "Tata Consultancy Services Q4 FY2027 results and fact sheet filed with BSE and NSE" --evidence "WHAT THE SOURCE SHOWS"

questions.text: Does Anthropic (Nasdaq: ANT) close below its $83 IPO price on any trading day from Nov 22, 2026 through Mar 31, 2027?
questions.test: YES if Anthropic (Nasdaq: ANT) closes below its $83 IPO price on any trading day from Nov 22, 2026 through Mar 31, 2027 (Nasdaq official closing price). NO otherwise.
questions.source: Nasdaq official closing prices for ANT
questions.evidence: ANT closed at $81.91 on Tue Nov 24, 2026, its first close below the $83 IPO price, and at $82.79 on Wed Nov 25 (Motley Fool's Nov 27 close of $91.88, up $9.09, implies the same $82.79 prior close). It closed back above the IPO price at $91.88 on Fri Nov 27.
questions.evidence_source: FinanceFeeds, Nov 27, 2026, https://financefeeds.com/ant-stock-at-91-88-back-above-its-83-ipo-price-on-black-friday/ ; Motley Fool, Nov 27, 2026, https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/27/stock-market-today-nov-27-anthropic-jumps-11-reclaiming-its-usd83-ipo-price-as-wall-street-rallies/ (secondary; Nasdaq's own close not read)
